rationale: Separate local raw-teacher overwrite from graph coupling and test visual correspondence. Main quality result is already known; posthoc mechanism audit, not new independent validation. Main recipe and all four running cold workers stay frozen.

controls.ANCHOR_ONLY: Same shared FINAL, raw known-teacher anchors, weak unknown unary and supported queries; zero all graph edges
controls.ANCHOR_CAL: Zero-edge anchors followed by original cue/PAVA
controls.SHUFFLED_CAL: Permute available cue-to-track pairing using existing fixed video/query hash, then same TrackID-excluding teacher-only prefix PAVA
controls.SHUFFLED_JOINT: Same protocol-pooled unary with independently refit permuted-cue PAVA; same cap, folds, QA budget, feature inputs

attribution_checks.simple_teacher_overwrite: Primary vs ANCHOR_ONLY: both directions all three neural seeds positive and parent+seed CI positive for a reliable claim beyond this ordinary hybrid
attribution_checks.graph_edges: CHECKLIST primary vs ANCHOR_CAL positive parent+seed CI; otherwise do not attribute pooled-module gain purely to edges
attribution_checks.visual_binding: C4 primary vs SHUFFLED_JOINT positive parent+seed CI for visual-correspondence claim
attribution_checks.failure_policy: Do not alter primary or running physical recipe, promote a control or hide negatives; narrow claims or continue research if a stronger simple baseline removes advantage
